SlWRKY41 is a member of WRKY transcription factor gene family which has been implicated in multiple biological processes in plants. It has the C2H2 Zinc-finger domain. SlWRKY41 is induced early by all stresses and is highly upregulated with the invasion of Clavibacter michiganensis subsp. michiganensis.
